title: The Top 10 Songs Played at Atlanta Strip Clubs in December 2025
summary: Pooh Shiesty makes his debut behind the surging "FDO."
contentText:
The holiday season came and went, and it was the most wonderful time of the year once again at Atlanta strip clubs. Patrons spread plenty of holiday cheer, while end-of-year bonuses turned into unforgettable nights with dollars flying to make sure it was a green Christmas in the ATL.

Billboard  launched the  inaugural strip club chart  in August and will continue to track the top tracks played monthly at three prominent Atlanta strip clubs.

For those new here,  Billboard  joined forces with DJ Monitor, a service that installs music-recognition technology for venues and festivals, along with a contribution from the Coalition DJs, to collect data from three different strip clubs in Atlanta.

There was some new blood on the December strip club chart to close out 2025, as Pooh Shiesty earned his first entry with his comeback single “FDO.”

Club DJs adopted another Billboard Hot 100 banger into their rotations with YoungBoy Never Broke Again’s “Shot Callin” making its debut. The MASA anthem has been a Hot 100 staple for about four months. TM88 also picked up a club hit while teaming up with Future for “Quadruple,” which landed on the 808 Mafia producer’s F.I.L.A 25 project, paying homage to Atlanta.

As far as the artists who had the most real estate on Atlanta strip club playlists for December, the top 10 goes as follows:

No. 10,  YoungBoy Never Broke Again  (149)
No. 9,  Gunna (165)
No. 8,  Young Thug  (174)
No. 7,  Gucci Mane  (181)
No. 6,  Young Nudy (214)
No. 5,  Jeezy  (228)
No. 4,  Metro Boomin  (266)
No. 3,  Bossman Dlow  (318)
No. 2,  Lil Baby  (343)
No. 1,  Future  (716)

U.S. club owners interested in contributing data can send an email to hiphop@billboard.com. Check out the top 10 songs going off in Atlanta strip clubs below.
